segments.he: וְהִנֵּה בְּאֵלּוּ הַשָּׁנִים נָסַעְתִּי כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים עַל הַמְּדִינָה בֵּין אַנְשֵׁי- שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ בִּשְׁבִיל לֶאֱסֹף מָמוֹן עוֹד לְהַעֲמִיד הַדְּפוּס אֲבָל לא עָלְתָה בְּיָדִי כַּנַּ"ל:
segments.en: And people gathered before him from several towns on legal matters. And he was also prepared to travel after Shavuos with his wife to the holy community of Kreminits to conduct the rabbinate there. And he wished to leave me here in Mohilov in his stead.
